svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Backend: PHP 8.3, Laravel 13, Python, Django. Frontend: Blade, Tailwind CSS, Vite. Datos: MySQL. Calidad: PHPUnit, Larastan, Pint. Entrega: Docker, Sail, Git, GitLab CI, GitHub.
